in_marathi.name: Dharmveer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharmveer is a name derived from Sanskrit origin, which is a combination of two words – Dharma (righteousness) and Veer (warrior). It is a revered name for boys in Hindu culture, symbolizing courage, strength, and righteousness. The name is deeply rooted in Indian mythology, where it is associated with various gods and legendary figures who embodied these virtues. The name carries a powerful spiritual meaning, urging individuals to stand up for justice and truth, and to live their lives with bravery and integrity.
